A1.justification: Both PDFs describe PepCompass and contain readable main text, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A–J. Matching content across layout changes supports a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original PoGS and LE-BO computational evaluations, stable-dimension measurements in Appendix B, and antimicrobial assays of four seeds and 25 optimized analogs in Section 3.3 and Appendix J.

after.justification: v4 retains these original computational results and wet-lab evaluations of 29 designed peptides against 19 bacterial strains. Retained results remain original empirical outcomes of the work.

M1.justification: Sections 2.2–2.7 and Algorithms 1–6 retain the same manifold construction, SORBES/SORBES-SE, MUTANG, local enumeration, LE-BO, and PoGS procedures. The appendix indexing corrections do not alter the proposed algorithms.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same HydrAMP and Veltri peptide data, antimicrobial optimization tasks, and bacterial strain panel. The HydrAMP-derived surrogate-training data coverage in Appendix H is also unchanged.

E2.justification: Tables 1–2 retain identical comparator membership for PoGS and LE-BO. The wet-lab comparison also retains HydrAMP, AMP-Diffusion, CLaSS, and Joker; no evaluated comparison method is added or removed.

E3.justification: The 300-pair PoGS evaluation, 1,400-evaluation optimization budget, Appendix H's 80/10/10 data split and training settings, and Appendix J's assay procedures are unchanged.

E4.justification: Both retain the PoGS potential ablation, LE-BO walk/mutation ablations, stable-dimension versus peptide-length analysis, and seed-family wet-lab breakdowns. No robustness test, ablation, or supplementary analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Both report Table 2 means and standard deviations over 10 optimization runs and independently triplicated wet-lab experiments in Appendix J.3. Run-count disclosures and uncertainty-reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: Tables 1–2 and empirical Figures 3, 4, 8, and 9 retain the same results. For example, LE-BO's KY14 result remains 0.50 ± 0.24 log2 MIC, with the same best-performance ranking on five of six starting peptides.

T1.justification: Appendix C corrects V(z)[:,d] to V(z)[:,d−1] in the orthogonal-complement span and Equation (11), making these expressions consistent with the stated zero-based indexing. This is a limited correction to the maximality derivation; theorem statements, assumptions, and other proofs remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and scientific claims, including geometry-informed peptide exploration, four discovered seeds, and 25 active optimized analogs. Their scope and strength are unchanged.

C2.justification: The interpretations of the walk/mutation ablations and predominantly Gram-negative optimization benefits are unchanged. The conclusion retains the same limitation concerning the Euclidean metric on ambient decoder outputs.

D1.justification: Appendices E–J retain the same implementation details, surrogate architecture, training and optimization hyperparameters, and laboratory procedures. The code-access disclosure and reproducibility statement are unchanged.

R1.justification: Both contain the same 60 cited works and retain Appendix A's research positioning. Added bibliographic fields and revised author or publication metadata, including references 43 and 46, do not introduce different works or change the relationship to prior research.

P1.justification: Editorial changes reorder the author list, replace unresolved '(author?)' placeholders with 'Schwarz et al.', and expand or correct bibliographic entries. The substantive narrative and section sequence remain essentially unchanged.

P2.justification: Existing figures and algorithm boxes reflow: Figures 4, 6, and 7 move to subsequent pages, and the conclusion is kept together after Table 2. Figures, table structures, plotted data, and captions otherwise retain their designs and content.

improvement.justification: v4 modestly improves mathematical consistency through the two Appendix C index corrections and improves attribution by resolving author placeholders and supplying fuller bibliographic information. These are useful local repairs; the methods, empirical support, reproducibility information, and substantive limitations remain unchanged.
